content.text: GitHub's AI secret scanning keeps creating false positives, for example [https://github.com/entireio/entire-graph/security/secret-scanning/17](https://github.com/entireio/entire-graph/security/secret-scanning/17) - can you change its rules to not do that? It's annoying af.
I’ll inspect that alert and the repository’s scanning settings, then narrow the false-positive source if GitHub exposes a control for it.
